content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, information, or medical-necessity issue, so another peer-to-peer or a necessity appeal would not properly address it. No documented coding correction supports resubmission, and billing the patient for a contractual bundling denial would be inappropriate. A human specialist must review the paid companion service and payer bundling/edit rules to determine whether a coding-based appeal or contractual adjustment is warranted."}
